addressed_findings.finding: Mutable caller/router kinds could make selected filters and reported evidence disagree during callbacks.
addressed_findings.resolution: Adapter freezes resolved kinds before ranking and uses frozen values for report construction; ranking-stage and DPM-stage mutation regressions pass.

addressed_findings.finding: Eager candidate collection could add an unnecessary full-store read or change fallback snapshot timing.
addressed_findings.resolution: Narrow ranked capability plus lazy recent source; successful ranking and ranking exceptions never read fallback state.

addressed_findings.finding: Independent schema-4 concurrency fixture initially tried migrating schema 3, which the existing migration contract refuses.
addressed_findings.resolution: Corrected only the test fixture to migrate schema 2. This was not a product failure; all schema-2/3/4 concurrency cases now pass.

addressed_findings.finding: Ledger documentation could imply that semantic ranking can never return an eligible older ledger.
addressed_findings.resolution: Final service docstring and gate documentation state the narrower guarantee: latest-ledger lookup does not fall back after suppression; semantic ranking retains its existing behavior.

review_conclusions: The existing public MemoryStore.retrieve_filtered remains the sole ranking implementation; no duplicated scoring was added.
The frozen request carries resolved scope, kinds, phase, top-k, time, and inspection state without mutable collection aliases.
Service functions do not import adapter ownership, locks, journals, or persistence and do not reach private mutable store state.
Fallback reads occur only after empty ranked success; exceptions preserve their identity and propagate.

All four scope fields, null subscope isolation, pinned expiry, suppression evidence order, phase asymmetry, empty kinds, ledger admission/deduplication, and context bytes/evidence remain characterized.
Controlled real contention shows cooperating retirement cannot commit until report materialization completes, across journal schemas 2, 3, and 4.
Report construction detaches metadata, collections, and personality overlay while preserving mutable response compatibility and construction-time digests.
Embedding I/O remains outside adapter ownership; receipt identity is checked before ranking inside ownership; DPM, metrics, and latency placement remain adapter responsibilities.
CI includes the four focused files in production evidence and the existing cross-platform matrix without replacing earlier gates.
scope_limits: Acceptance applies to the scoped exact retrieve_context extraction for receipt schemas 2/3/4 and characterized legacy/schema-1 compatibility.
No new public candidate API, durable schema, migration format, or maturity promotion is qualified by this gate.
Legacy hybrid retrieval, ANN, automatic retrieval quality adjustments, DPM, and native KV remain outside production qualification.
Token counts remain estimates; complete model-input/tokenizer binding and durable full-context replay are not added.
This independent grader ran focused checks only; full-suite, cross-platform execution, model/GPU/network behavior, and large-store performance claims are not independently established here.
Only temporary synthetic stores were used; no user memory data was read or changed, and no commit or push was performed.
The parent may append final verification numbers or artifact links to documentation after these reviewed document hashes; that does not change accepted runtime/test/CI hashes.
